# manual case: FXC on Compiler Explorer (fxc_10_0_19041)
# why manual: the issue's central claim is that FXC accepts this. That is not a
#   dxc invocation, so triage.py run cannot capture it. Re-run with:
#     python ce-probe.py fxc_10_0_19041 repro.hlsl "/T ps_5_0 /E main"
# harness: ce-probe.py, which calls triage.py's own ce_compile (same API call
#   and same output filters that triage.py godbolt uses)
# note: FXC only supports shader model 5.x, hence /T ps_5_0 rather than the
#   ps_6_0 in cmd.txt. That is the only difference from the DXC probes.
# expect: both cases compile (exit 0) -- if FXC ever rejected them the
#   fxc-disagrees label and the report's premise would both be wrong
# captured: 2026-08-06T20:19:25Z

$ [compiler-explorer] fxc_10_0_19041 /T ps_5_0 /E main  (repro.hlsl)
[exit] 0
